preconditions.description: The number of stations is between 1 and 200,000.
The number of two-way railways is between 1 and 300,000.
The number of incidents is between 0 and 200,000.
The cost to build a railway from station 1 to i is between 1 and 1,000,000,000.
The stations connected by a two-way railway are between 1 and n.
The two stations connected by a two-way railway are different.
The length of a two-way railway is between 1 and 1,000,000,000.
The station to which the cost of building a railway is increased is between 1 and n.
The amount by which the cost of building a railway is increased is between 1 and 400,000,000.
